info.name: EvolutionaryScale Forge ESM3 Embeddings Encoding API

items.docs: Convert an `ESMProtein` into an `ESMProteinTensor` representation by running the structure tokenizer (and other per-track tokenizers) over the input. The tensor representation is required for low-level forward_and_sample and logits operations.
Inverse of encode. Runs the structure token decoder to convert an `ESMProteinTensor` back into an `ESMProtein` with sequence and atom coordinates.
